findings.current: the Beast Miao King, who had been restraining him
findings.defect: The draft turns an attempt to dissuade or stop Jeok Cheongang into physical restraint, changing the Beast Miao King’s action.
findings.rationale: 만류하던 means he was trying to dissuade or stop Jeok Cheongang; it does not establish that he physically restrained him.
findings.replacement: the Beast Miao King, who had been trying to stop him

findings.current: I muttered the words like a groan and gazed at the pillars of water blocking me in with stunned eyes.
findings.defect: The singular water column surrounding him is changed into multiple pillars.
findings.rationale: 물의 기둥 is singular, and the scene consistently presents one enormous column enclosing him.
findings.replacement: I muttered the words like a groan and gazed with stunned eyes at the column of water walling me in on every side.
findings.source: 신음처럼 중얼거린 나는 아연한 눈빛으로 사방을 가로막은 물의 기둥을 바라보았다.

findings.current: But the reason everything surrounding me felt so distant was the single object shining alone between the slowly dispersing pillars of water.
findings.defect: The draft again changes the single dispersing water column into multiple pillars.
findings.rationale: 물기둥 remains singular; 사이에서 describes the object becoming visible amid or through the dispersing water.
findings.replacement: But the reason everything surrounding me felt so distant was the single object shining alone through the slowly dispersing column of water.
findings.source: 그러나 지금 나를 둘러싼 모든 것이 멀게만 느껴지는 이유는, 서서히 흩어지는 물기둥 사이에서 홀로 빛나고 있는 한 가지 물건 때문이었다.

findings.current: At the same time, the pillars of water blocking every direction shot into the sky and burst apart like an explosion.
findings.defect: The draft changes the single enclosing water column into multiple pillars at the moment it erupts.
findings.rationale: The source uses the singular 물기둥 and describes that one column surging upward and bursting.
findings.replacement: At the same time, the column of water walling me in on every side shot into the sky and burst apart like an explosion.
findings.source: 사방을 가로막고 있던 물기둥이 하늘 위로 솟구침과 동시에 폭발하듯 터져 나갔다.

findings.current: They didn’t know that a green leaf had just poked its head up above them, nourished by the rain falling onto their heads.
findings.defect: The draft places the emerging leaf above the characters and adds an explicit claim that the rain nourished it.
findings.rationale: The source says the leaf has newly emerged amid the rain falling over their heads; it does not locate the leaf above them or explicitly explain the rain as nourishment.
findings.replacement: They didn’t know that a green leaf had just poked its head out beneath the rain falling on them.
findings.source: 자신들의 머리 위로 떨어져 내리고 있는 빗물에, 지금 막 푸른 잎사귀가 불쑥 고개를 내밀었다는 것을.

findings.current: No. It might have been the memory of the divine artifact that had shared its birth, this land, and its fate.
findings.defect: The coordination is malformed and obscures the causal history: the artifact has shared this land’s fate since its birth.
findings.rationale: 탄생과 이 땅과 운명을 함께해 온 links the artifact’s existence from birth to its shared fate with the land, rather than listing “this land” as something it shared.
findings.replacement: No. It might have been the memories of the divine artifact that had shared this land’s fate since its birth.
findings.source: 아니, 탄생과 이 땅과 운명을 함께해 온 신물(神物)의 기억일지도 모른다.

findings.current: They shone countless times like stars in the night sky before fading away, and eventually, a snow-white White Tiger began guarding the sacred stone.
findings.defect: “Shone countless times” suggests that the same beings repeatedly shone, rather than countless successive beings appearing and fading over the long history.
findings.rationale: 수없이 modifies the number or succession of beings that shone and faded, reinforcing the passage of generations before the White Tiger became guardian.
findings.replacement: Countless among them shone like stars in the night sky before fading away, and eventually, a snow-white White Tiger began guarding the sacred stone.
findings.source: 그들은 밤하늘의 별처럼 수없이 빛났다가 사그라들었고, 이내 눈처럼 새하얀 한 마리의 백호가 신석을 지키기 시작했다.

findings.current: *……But if this backfires, we’re really in for one hell of a disaster.*
findings.defect: The generic “disaster” loses the deliberately comic, slangy image of a full-blown chaos party.
findings.rationale: 대환장 파티 is an irreverent colloquial expression for an absurdly chaotic mess, matching Taekyung’s profane action-comedy narration.
findings.replacement: *……But if this backfires, we’re in for a total shitshow.*
findings.source: ‘……근데 이거, 잘못해서 역효과 나면 진짜 대환장 파티 시작인데.’

findings.defect: The draft both softens the profanity and renders 딱 여기네 as an unclear question about location rather than the realization that this is exactly the anticipated reaction.
findings.rationale: 시벌 is a comic spelling of strong profanity, while 딱 여기네 expresses recognition that the expected event has arrived or this is exactly it.

findings.current: Snow-white fur fluttered in a breeze that had come from somewhere, and the blue-white eyes that had grown clearer and sharper looked exactly like someone from my memories.
findings.defect: Eyes cannot naturally look exactly like an entire person; the intended comparison is to that remembered person’s eyes.
findings.rationale: The source uses a natural metonymic comparison, but English requires “those of” to make the referent clear.
findings.replacement: Snow-white fur fluttered in a breeze that had come from somewhere, and the blue-white eyes, now clearer and more distinct, looked exactly like those of someone from my memories.
findings.source: 어디선가 불어온 바람에 눈처럼 새하얀 터럭이 흩날리고, 한층 맑고 또렷해진 청백색의 눈동자는 기억 속 누군가를 쏙 닮아 있었다.

summary: The draft contains one altered action, several changes to physical quantity or location, two historical-mechanism errors, losses of comic register, and System-panel formatting violations.
